failed: {count} Stripe webhook events failed to process in the last 7 days. Queue each again with the replay command once the cause is fixed.
failedOlder: {count} Stripe webhook events last failed to process more than 7 days ago. Queue each again with the replay command (gym-app replay --gym <gym-id> <event-id>).
pending: Stripe webhooks are waiting to be processed.
waiting: Stripe is connected and its webhook endpoint is registered. No webhook has arrived yet; Stripe sends one with the first payment event.
